source: Mirrored from github.com/ollybat/spinback-rce-bot at src/commands, one file per command. Names, descriptions, tiers, usages and options are copied from those files; nothing here was written by hand except the group labels.
updated: Mirrored from the bot repository on request.

commands.name: setup
commands.summary: Set up roles, log channels and the Rust server

commands.name: help
commands.summary: Every command, by staff tier, on a card you can page through

commands.name: ping
commands.summary: Health check: bot latency, the settings store, RCON, feeds and what is down

commands.name: user
commands.summary: Your link: your in-game name, your clan and your zone

commands.name: players
commands.summary: Who is on the Rust server right now, and which clan each name wears

commands.name: server
commands.summary: Whether the Rust server is up, who is on, and the bot\u2019s own readings

commands.name: kits
commands.summary: Emote kits: make them, hand them out, clear cooldowns, set respawn kits

options.name: build
options.description: The kit panel: make, edit, set binds, choose respawn kits

options.name: kit
options.description: Open one kit straight away

options.name: page
options.description: Which page of the list

options.name: give
options.description: Give a kit to a gamertag, or to a member who ran /user

options.name: kit
options.description: Which kit

options.name: who
options.description: A gamertag, as typed in game

options.name: member
options.description: Or a Discord member the bot has linked

options.name: clear
options.description: Clear their cooldown first

options.name: refresh
options.description: Clear kit cooldowns: one person, one kit, or everything

options.name: kit
options.description: Every cooldown this kit holds

options.name: member
options.description: One person, and every kit they took

options.name: all
options.description: Everybody, every kit (admin)

options.name: auth
options.description: Who is in an Auth Group in Rust

options.name: spawn
options.description: The kit an Auth Group is handed each time its members respawn

options.name: group
options.description: Which Auth Group

options.name: kit
options.description: Which kit - leave it out to pick one from a list

options.name: off
options.description: Give this group nothing on respawn

commands.name: Servers
commands.summary: Run a line on the Rust server console

commands.name: leaderboard
commands.summary: The clan boards: most members, who holds ground, and who is busiest

commands.name: where-am-i
commands.summary: Ask the game where you are standing, and show the numbers

options.name: user
options.description: Staff: somebody else, by their link

commands.name: clan-create
commands.summary: Start a clan: a name, a tag and a colour

options.name: name
options.description: What the clan is called

options.name: tag
options.description: The short tag worn in front, like RUST

options.name: colour
options.description: The colour the clan card wears - only the ones this server allows

commands.name: clan-info
commands.summary: Show a clan: members, home, zone, code (yours by default)

options.name: clan
options.description: A name, [TAG] or join code

commands.name: clan-view
commands.summary: Staff: look inside any clan, or list every one

options.name: clan
options.description: A name, [TAG] or code

options.name: all
options.description: Every clan at a glance

commands.name: clan-edit
commands.summary: Change your clan name, tag, colour or note
commands.usage: clan-edit colour:gold note:Recruiting for the next wipe

options.name: name
options.description: A new name

options.name: tag
options.description: A new tag

options.name: colour
options.description: A new colour - only the ones this server allows

options.name: note
options.description: A line under the clan title

commands.name: clan-delete
commands.summary: Disband your clan - staff may name any clan, or wipe them all

options.name: clan
options.description: Staff: a name, [TAG] or code instead of your own

options.name: all
options.description: Staff (admin): remove every clan

options.name: confirm
options.description: Say True to mean it

commands.name: clan-invite
commands.summary: Invite somebody to your clan, or cancel an invitation

options.name: user
options.description: Who to invite, or whose invitation to cancel

options.name: cancel
options.description: Cancel the invitation instead of sending one

commands.name: clan-join
commands.summary: Join a clan with its code, or accept an invitation

options.name: code
options.description: The join code, if nobody invited you

commands.name: clan-kick
commands.summary: Remove a member from your clan (leader and co-leaders)

options.name: user
options.description: The member to remove

commands.name: clan-promote
commands.summary: Make a clan member a co-leader (the leader decides this)

options.name: user
options.description: The member to promote

commands.name: clan-demote
commands.summary: Take a co-leader back down to member

options.name: user
options.description: The co-leader to demote

commands.name: clan-leave
commands.summary: Leave your clan (a leader hands it on, or it disbands)

commands.name: clan-transfer
commands.summary: Staff: hand a clan to another member

options.name: user
options.description: The member who takes it

options.name: clan
options.description: Which clan, when it is not yours

commands.name: clan-sethome
commands.summary: Set the clan home to where you are standing - once, and only a leader may

commands.name: clan-sync
commands.summary: Put your clan role and private channel in place, or repair them

options.name: clan
options.description: Staff: a name, [TAG] or code instead of your own

options.name: all
options.description: Staff (admin): put every clan in order

commands.name: clan-code
commands.summary: Show your clan join code

commands.name: clan-codechange
commands.summary: Make a new join code, so the old one stops working

commands.name: clan-config
commands.summary: Staff: open the clan settings panel

commands.name: active-clans
commands.summary: Every clan on the server, biggest first

commands.name: zorp-create
commands.summary: Create your clan zone where you are standing, and pick how big it is

options.name: size
options.description: How wide the zone is, in metres - only the sizes this server allows

options.name: name
options.description: A name for the zone, like Main base

commands.name: zorp-toggle
commands.summary: Switch your clan zone between green and red

commands.name: zorp-delete
commands.summary: Remove your clan zone - admins may name any zone, or clear them all

options.name: zone
options.description: Admins: a zone name or an admin zone

options.name: all
options.description: Admins: clear every clan zone (asks for confirm)

options.name: confirm
options.description: With all: say True to mean it

commands.name: zorp-forceedit
commands.summary: Staff: force a zone colour or size, whatever the clan wanted

options.name: zone
options.description: A clan name, a zone name or an admin zone

options.name: colour
options.description: Force this state

options.name: size
options.description: Force this size, 10-300 metres

commands.name: zorp-config
commands.summary: Staff: open the zorp settings panel

commands.name: zorp-createadmin
commands.summary: Staff: a white admin zone where you are standing, for events and safe areas
commands.usage: zorp-createadmin name:Trade Post size:60 pvp:False build:True

options.name: name
options.description: What the zone is called

options.name: size
options.description: How wide it is, 10-300 metres

options.name: pvp
options.description: Allow PvP inside

options.name: damage
options.description: Allow damage to buildings

options.name: build
options.description: Allow building inside

options.name: enter
options.description: A line shown on the way in

options.name: leave
options.description: A line shown on the way out

commands.name: zorp-portal
commands.summary: Staff: portals - add, remove or list them. The entrance is where you stand

options.name: action
options.description: What to do

options.name: name
options.description: The portal name - suggestions list the ones that exist

options.name: to
options.description: Exit, like -450 1200 - or leave it off and set it from where you stand

options.name: note
options.description: A line about it

commands.name: zorp-bansystem
commands.summary: Staff: the zorp ban list - add, remove or read it

options.name: action
options.description: What to do

options.name: user
options.description: A Discord member

options.name: gamertag
options.description: An in-game name - suggestions list linked or banned names

options.name: reason
options.description: Why, for the record

options.name: hours
options.description: How long it lasts, 1-720 hours - leave it out for one that stands
